name: ginga-node
description: Node.js middleware and static asset distribution package for GingaF Flutter Web

scripts.flutter:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); if (!fs.existsSync('../gingaf/ginga/build/web/index.html')) cp.execSync('cd ../gingaf/ginga && flutter build web --release', { stdio: 'inherit' }); else console.log('Flutter web build exists, skipping build.');"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist', 'site', 'public/gingaf-web'].forEach(d => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.build: npm run flutter:build && npm run copy:assets && npm run bundle:examples && vite build && tsc
